t: GitHub - kantamasuki/RGDM: Implementations of the renormalization group-based diffusion model (RGDM).
s: Renormalization group-based diffusion model (RGDM) is a generative diffusion model based on the exact renormalization group, which leverages multiscale structures inherent in natural data, such as the protein structures and images. In this Github repository, we provide the Python codes used in the numerical experiments described in the paper.
